description: Northern Provincial  Council - Notifying that the Transfer of Court Fines and Penalties Statute of the Northern Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content enacts a new statute (Transfer of Court fines and Penalties Statute No. 01 of 2017) that establishes legal procedures for transferring court-collected fines and penalties to local authorities. It creates a regulatory framework for financial transfers between provincial and local government entities, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
